title: Extract Value from Bit Field (Macro)

parameters.name: reg
parameters.description: The register value to extract from

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: Bit mask defining the target field

parameters.name: shift
parameters.description: Number of bits to right-shift after masking

constraints: mask contains one or more contiguous set bits
shift equals the position of the mask's lowest set bit
All values are valid 32-bit unsigned integers
